observations: Current producer callback retains a unique_incoming_ flag check inside the emitted records. Deferred incoming validation removes this check but did not explain the reported sparse whole-program regression.

The current assembly emits RadixHeap<unsigned long, int>::pop_value separately, while the old ordinary Dijkstra run inlines it. The old-queue candidate was slower on the screened sparse case, so reverting it was rejected.
Input, build, path and run noinline candidates did not provide a stable broad improvement. No noinline or code-alignment change was selected.
Equal stack-frame sizes do not prove equal register-spill costs. No claim that register allocation caused the earlier regression is made.
